description: User cannot log in: wrong or forgotten password, locked account, MFA/one-time code problems, or an unknown login error. Diagnoses the cause from the error, guides self-service fixes, and hands account checks to an operator.

facts.name: account_locked
facts.description: Operator-confirmed lock status of the account in the admin system

facts.name: reset_done
facts.description: Whether the user completed a password reset via Forgot Password

facts.name: login_works
facts.description: Whether the user can now log in successfully

steps.instruction: Ask the user for the exact error message shown when they try to log in. Never ask for the password.
Check in the admin system whether the user account is locked.
Unlock the account in the admin system following the approved procedure, then confirm it is unlocked.
Ask the user to reset their password using the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page and tell us once the reset is complete.
Ask the user to check that their phone's time is set automatically, then try a fresh authenticator code or a backup code, and confirm whether they can log in.
Ask the user to try logging in again and confirm whether it works.
